entries.title: Proverbs 13:1
segments: A wise son [heeds] his father's instruction, but a scorner does not hear rebuke.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:2
segments: From the fruit of [his] mouth a man shall eat good, but the soul of the treacherous [eats] violence.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:3
segments: He who keeps his mouth keeps his life; he who opens his lips wide, [it is] ruin to him.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:4
segments: The soul of the sluggard desires and [has] nothing; but the soul of the hard worker shall be made fat.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:5
segments: The righteous hates lying, but the wicked one is odious and acts shamefully.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:6
segments: Righteousness guards the perfect of way, but wickedness subverts sin.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:7
segments: There are [those] who act rich, yet have nothing; and those who act poor, yet [have] great riches.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:8
segments: The ransom of a man's life [is] his riches, but the poor does not hear rebuke.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:9
segments: The light of the righteous rejoices, but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:10
segments: Only by pride comes argument, but with those who take advice [is] wisdom.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:11
segments: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be taken away, but he who gathers by labor shall increase.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:12
segments: Hope put off makes the heart sick, but desire fulfilled [is] a tree of life.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:13
segments: Whoever despises the word shall be destroyed, but he who fears the commandment shall be rewarded.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:14
segments: The law of the wise [is] a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:15
segments: Good understanding gives favor, but the way of traitors [is] ever flowing.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:16
segments: Every wise one deals with knowledge, but a fool lays open [his] folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:17
segments: A wicked messenger falls into mischief, but a faithful ambassador [is] health.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:18
segments: Poverty and shame [shall be to] him who refuses instruction, but he who listens to correction shall be honored.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:19
segments: The desire fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but [it is] hateful to fools to turn from evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:20
segments: He who walks with the wise shall be wise, but a companion [with] fools shall be destroyed.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:21
segments: Evil pursues sinners, but to the righteous good shall be repaid.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:22
segments: A good [man] leaves an inheritance to his sons' sons, and the wealth of the sinner [is] laid up for the just.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:23
segments: Much food [is] in the plowed ground of the poor, but when [there is] no justice, it is swept away.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:24
segments: He who spares his rod hates his son, but he who loves him chastens him early.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:25
segments: The righteous eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked shall lack.
